newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1998 budget debate - key dates.
newsitem.headline: French 1998 budget debate - key dates.

text.p: The following are key dates in the French 1998 budget adoption process.
August 8 - Prime Minister Lionel Jospin hands down preliminary budget decisions ministry by ministry. These decisions are followed by negotiations between the various ministers and Jospin.
September 24 - Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn presents 1998 Finance Act draft to cabinet.
October 14-17 - National Assembly debates revenue side of budget bill.
October 21-November 19 - National Assembly debates spending plans ministry by ministry.
October 27-29 - National Assembly interrupts Finance Act debate to examine 1998 social security financing bill.
December 11 - National Assembly and Senate proceed with second reading of budget law with final adoption of 1998 Finance Act expected around the 20 December.
